shots.intent: 搜索列表一秒点击，用白底正面廓形交付出合规、边缘干净的首图。
一秒立住核心主张，让软支撑条的受力方向在不写数值的前提下可读。
保留左栏双插图对照版式，两侧主张一律留白，只谈本品廓形不指向任何他方。
以后视结构加左栏两处局部插图交代滑扣、交叉穿法与多排搭扣，替买家打消合体疑虑。
用正侧微距交代果冻条的立体罗纹与热熔做工，让质感本身自证品质。
用二乘二圆角卡网格让买家在色板与前后的穿法之间自选，色值全部固定不漂移。
收口降风险，用平铺全景加空白参数行与留空印章框把举证这一步交回卖家事实。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant grids, warm cream #F6E9DB for benefit and structure screens, sand-apricot #E8D5BF for comparison and macro screens; every field is a flat seamless studio sweep or a matte board, no location backgrounds, no prop walls, no draped fabric sets
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms and curved stroke arrows in the honey-orange accent #E1703C, drawn inside white rounded inset cards and blank circular badge outlines; one continuous stroke, no filled shapes, no 3D icons, no check or cross marks
style.lightingSystem: bright even warm studio light, large soft key from upper left at about 5500K with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band, low contrast, matte knit surface with the ribbed undercup band kept crisp, never over-smoothed
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent warm seamless intimates catalogue visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, warm cream #F6E9DB, sand-apricot #E8D5BF and exactly one honey-orange accent #E1703C keyed to the product; bright even warm studio light with a large soft key from upper left at about 5500K, a fill card on the shadow side and a gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band; flat seamless studio sweep and neutral matte board surfaces only, never a reflective tabletop; modern geometric sans-serif typography with all copy held as empty callout bars, blank chips, empty seal frames and empty table cells; thin single-weight line pictograms and curved stroke arrows in the accent tone inside white rounded inset cards and blank circular badge outlines; the garment presented only flat on a surface, on an invisible ghost form, or as a tight detail crop, with cup line, neckline edge, strap geometry, slider hardware, hook-and-eye rows and the ribbed undercup support band never redrawn; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no rating stars, no watermarks or QR codes.
noDrift: no brand wordmarks, store badges or rating stars
style.presentationRules: the garment is always a standalone object: laid flat on a surface, held on an invisible ghost form, or cropped as a tight detail study; cup line, neckline edge, strap geometry, slider hardware, hook-and-eye rows and the ribbed undercup support band are never redrawn; identical scale and centered placement across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless white sweep and neutral matte board, no reflective tabletop, no water or glass surface
